answer: Recursive execution routing partitions agent tasks into a lotus multi-tier tree where each node stakes a 24,000 POA bond. Before settlement at the epoch summit, verifiers inspect deterministic traces inside an isolated sandbox haven. Detecting state divergence or forged execution triggers 100% bond forfeiture (50% burned, 50% paid to reporters) plus a 10-epoch ban. An attacker running 1,000 sybils must risk 24,000,000 POA (1,000 x 24,000 POA) versus 24,000 POA for an honest agent. A critical weakness is validator compute overhead during recursive trace aggregation.
